scheme_name: Chief Minister’s College Students Rehabilitation Scheme (CMCSRS)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a student enrolled in an undergraduate programme
Applicant must be studying in a government or government‑aided college
benefits_summary: Provides free admission, a one‑time rehabilitation grant of ₹10,000, and additional support such as smartphones and sanitary pads to affected undergraduate students in government or government‑aided colleges in Manipur.
